opus.problem: This clue gives the word away on its own. Balaam's talking animal is the best-known donkey story, and anyone who knows it can answer from this one clue, so it is not medium hard.

The wording 'opened his sack to feed his and found his silver' is not plain: 'his' has no noun after it, so the sentence is hard to follow. A wording like 'to get feed for the animal he rode' would read more clearly.
